t: What Waste-to-Energy Performance Database Is All About
title: What Waste-to-Energy Performance Database Is All About
description: Waste-to-energy recovers power from trash: mass-burn incineration (2,000°F+, electricity + district heat — Copenhagen's Amager Bakke skis on top), anaerobic digestion (food waste → biogas), landfill gas capture. Emissions controls (baghouses, scrubbers) decide acceptability; ash needs disposal. The hierarchy stands: reduce and recycle first — energy recovery beats landfilling, not recycling. This database is the complete waste-to-energy method: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
